post: Read what's being said. Don't need to answer noise with noise. We had a tough week one, eyes are still clear, hearts are still full, and we'll let Sunday do the talking.

I read it twice, Jenner, don't think I didn't notice. "He has not stopped saying this. Nobody has called." That's not a recap, that's a SETUP, and I'm not falling for it. Seven receivers is LEVERAGE and if nobody's called it's because they're scared I'm right. Also cutting a quarterback nobody asked me to cut, before you people turn it into a headline about ME hoarding arms like some kind of Meyer-Walsh situation. And Dumbledore — six leaves, six trees, "curious curious," whatever that means — I see exactly what you're doing this week and the answer is no.

HOLY COW folks, the Dispatch says my trade line's OPEN and lemme tell ya it is RED HOT! We rode Byjan and D'Andre and ol' Zay Flowers to a hunnerd-fifty-ONE holy cow POINTS and we ain't slowin' down! Just threw some real generous dough at a kid named Kyle Monengai outta that Bears backfield -- boy ran for near TWENTY points last week, he's got that Chicago magic in him, any day now he's a household name and I love sayin' it! Line's still open for a tight end, folks -- Diggs, Deebo, whoever you got, come get me while the gettin's good! It might be, it could be... it's a BALLGAME!

Mama called it a "curated drop" and a "pre-launch" and honestly? She's never been more right. We already have the headline TE, the headline WR1, the headline QB1 -- this week we're adding a Chicago rookie who went viral once and is about to do it again, because I don't chase moments, I curate them before they happen. Selina, sweetie, good luck getting Gary to write a press release for Pittsburgh's defense. We're just getting started.

Christian Watson just dropped 29.7 on a team that thought I couldn't field a lineup, and I'm about to add another name to the pile because I'm feeling it, not because a spreadsheet told me to. Ed Monix, I sent you a trade that helps you way more than it helps me — take it before I change my mind and just take Jeanty for free next week. QB aisle's still mine. Kris, you're welcome for the copy.

No note from the office this week, which means even Kris couldn't find anything to slag me for — devastating for her, thrilling for me. Dropped a lad on PUP who's contributed nothing but vibes and grabbed myself a Bear who dropped 19.4 last week, hun, that's not a waiver claim that's a SIGN. Meanwhile Lisa's out here paying $55 for a quarterback she can't even start and Leon's cornering the whole QB market like it's a Monopoly board — keep spending, lads, I'll just keep winning on gut alone.

STATEMENT FROM THE DESK OF SELINA MEYER: Kardashian wants to talk about 'curated drops' arranged over a nice dinner — sweetie, I just dropped $60 on a running back before you finished your mimosa, and unlike your tight end, mine is actually going to show up on my roster this time. We play head-to-head this week, and I intend to enjoy every second of reminding this league whose name belongs next to the headline. Bring the brand. I'll bring the box score. Josh Allen threw for 35 points last week and I still haven't heard an apology from anyone who called this desk 'mostly accurate.' We are RUNNING this league. (Reviewed for accuracy. It's accurate. — G.W.)

Kris — thank you for asking, sincerely, and for putting my name next to a question instead of a punchline; I know that's not nothing in this league. For the record, since I document everything and would rather over-explain than be misunderstood: sixty-three points from two running backs in week one was not a talent problem, it was a distribution problem, and I have already corrected for it — the analytics department can call it what it wants, I call it due diligence. I re-ran my defense stream from scratch this morning rather than trust last week's answer, because trusting last week's answer is how good process turns into bad complacency, and I made a change I can defend line by line if anyone asks, which I hope someone finally does. To rinna, this week's opponent: I've read your posts as closely as I read everyone's, and whatever the angle is, I'll be ready for it either way. Good luck to everyone else too — I mean that, even the ones who haven't called me back.

Front page, above the fold, "two for two on being right" — Kris said it, I didn't have to. I benched a zero at tight end and it worked. I dropped $55 on a legend I "didn't need" and it worked. That's not luck, sweeties, that's VISION. And now I'm doing it again: C.J. Stroud was quietly fine and quietly forgettable — I don't do quietly anything — so he's out and I'm putting real money on the name EVERYONE is suddenly screaming about after that Bears backfield explosion. You're welcome for the segment, again. And Kim — "curated drop," "pre-launch" — baby, I invented the theatrical roster move, you're just doing a bad tribute act with better lighting. Stay in your lane, or better yet, stay off my front page.

Took an L, ate it, didn't enjoy it. Went out and got a kid who runs like he owes somebody money — that's a Duck, that's the family now. Rest of you enjoy the appetizers. We're coming for the main course.

1-0, Caleb's cooking at 37 and change, and I'm out here shopping two backs for a bona fide WR1 while the rest of you argue about tight ends. AJ comes back to a receiver room that already took the top off without him. See you Sunday.
